reason: Proper halal-certified collagen is hard to find, and part of every sale going to feed families is exactly the kind of brand I want to back, so I'd try one pouch at £18. I'm not signing up to a subscription until I know I'll actually take it every day.
objection: Unflavoured powder sounds like a hassle every morning with a baby and a job, and I'm worried it'll clump or make my tea taste off and end up sitting in the cupboard. It also doesn't say if it's actually Muslim-owned or who certifies it.
